newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PNCC bags three infrastructure projects.
newsitem.headline: PNCC bags three infrastructure projects.

text.p: Philippine National Construction Corp (PNCC) said on Thursday it had entered into three infrastructure agreements with different government agencies.

The company told the Philippine Stock Exchange in a statement that it recently signed an agreement with the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office to repair and renovate a state-run hospital in Manila for 58.93 million pesos.
It also said Clark Development Corp had tapped the company to design and build a major bridge linking the main freeport zone to the neighbouring towns.
In addition, a memorandum of agreement was signed with Asset Privatisation Trust to provide technical assistance in developing a 158 hectare lot in Cavite, just south of Manila.
Terms of the last two contracts were not disclosed.
